# openwrt_firewall_defaults (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt firewall default policies.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_helper` (Boolean) Automatically create helper rules for active connections.
- `drop_invalid` (Boolean) Drop invalid packets.
- `forward` (String) Forward policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
- `input` (String) Input policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
- `output` (String) Output policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
- `synflood_protect` (Boolean) Enable SYN flood protection.
- `synflood_rate` (String) SYN flood rate limit (e.g., '25/s').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: firewall/defaults.
